vllm_omni/deploy/minicpmo_4_5_turn.yaml.content:
# MiniCPM-o 4.5 using the turn-based engine and ordinary HTTP serving.
base_config: minicpmo_4_5.yaml
session_mode: turn

stages:
  - stage_id: 0
    # CUDA V1 and MRv2 restore cached Thinker outputs for the Talker.
    # Other platforms keep their existing overrides below and in the base.
    enable_prefix_caching: true

platforms:
  cuda:
    stages:
      - stage_id: 0
        # Keep the turn engine's upstream kernel and compilation defaults.
        kernel_config: {}
        compilation_config: {}
  rocm:
    stages:
      - stage_id: 0
        enable_prefix_caching: false
  xpu:
    stages:
      - stage_id: 0
        enable_prefix_caching: false
  musa:
    stages:
      - stage_id: 0
        enable_prefix_caching: false

vllm_omni/deploy/minicpmo_4_5.yaml.content:
# MiniCPM-o 4.5 three-stage deploy on one large-memory GPU.
pipeline: minicpmo_4_5
# Keep MRv1 on other platforms; CUDA selects MRv2 below.
model_runner: v1
async_chunk: true
# Use minicpmo_4_5_turn.yaml to select the ordinary turn-based serving engine.
session_mode: duplex
# Keep the active window aligned with the session and stage capacities below.
# A smaller window serializes first-packet generation for concurrent chat turns.
duplex_session:
  # Matches Stage 0/1 max_num_seqs below.
  max_sessions: 16

trust_remote_code: true
enable_prefix_caching: false

connectors:
  connector_of_shared_memory:
    name: SharedMemoryConnector
    extra:
      # Talker codec prelude: one Triton kernel for the rep-penalty and
      # temperature steps on NPU. Defaults to on; set false to force the eager
      # chain for accuracy triage (e.g. after a CANN/torch_npu upgrade). It is
      # a no-op off NPU or without Triton.
      # talker_codec_fused_prelude: false
      connector_get_sleep_s: 0.01
      connector_get_max_wait_first_chunk: 3000
      connector_get_max_wait: 300
      # Payload length in codec frames, the same for every payload. The
      # request-level initial_codec_chunk_frames parameter still exists for a
      # smaller first packet; this profile no longer splits the first window at
      # the deploy level -- with the steady window itself at 25 frames a
      # separate first chunk only added a seam between the first chunk and the
      # rest.
      codec_chunk_frames: 25
      codec_left_context_frames: 3
      # HiFT capture buckets are derived from codec_chunk_frames and
      # codec_left_context_frames. (#5869)
      enable_hift_graph: true
      # Merge the ragged K-step CFM shapes into one solve per step, otherwise
      # every ragged bucket captures its own graph.
      cfm_cross_bucket_merge: true
      # Capture batch-1 continuation/tail shapes without padding: with the
      # 8-frame mel cache these codec widths cover 14-76 mel frames. The lower
      # end (3) is a short tail chunk and the upper end (29-34) is a tail chunk
      # merged with a small backlog; both used to miss every bucket and run
      # eager HiFT (32 of 798 decode calls in the 2026-10-30 c8 round, and the
      # last 7 of 1088 prompts on CUDA seed-tts EN, all (1, 76, 3840) =
      # codec width 34, one past the previous 33 cap).
      hift_graph_continuation_frames: [3, 34]
      # Batch 2 was the last eager residue: every batch-2 continuation shape
      # missed both the buckets (only 1/2/4/8 x 50/58 are captured) and the
      # batch-1 exact graphs (2026-10-30: 5 of 798 decode calls).
      hift_graph_exact_batch_sizes: [1, 2]
      enable_cfm_graph: true
      # Fused CFM DiT body: CUDA via TF32, NPU via packed QKV + ACLNN
      # AddLayerNorm + im2col-GEMM convolutions and a single cache transpose.
      cfm_fused_body: true
      # Enable NPU cross-reference CFM batching for same-shape and ragged
      # requests, including different token/query, reference prompt and
      # conformer/CFM attention-history lengths and mixed final-chunk flags.
      # Requires FP32 fused Whole-Euler, FP32 attention caches, no slot pool
      # and code2wav_min_batch_size=1; otherwise warn and retain existing dispatch.
      # Encoder/HiFT run in compatible subgroups; CFM uses per-request masks,
      # noise offsets and cache trimming. CNN/HiFT cache shapes, dtypes,
      # devices and the cache-epoch policy still constrain batching.
      # Enabled in this profile; set false to disable. No effect off NPU.
      cfm_npu_cross_reference_batching: true
      # Small exact encoder batches share one startup arena; larger batches
      # replay in groups, preserving cache lengths without batch padding.
      enable_code2wav_encoder_graph: true
      code2wav_encoder_graph_rows: 4
      code2wav_encoder_max_graphs: 12
      code2wav_encoder_capture_after: 8
      # Admit C32 to Whole-Euler while reserving workspace for only four
      # requests. Persistent request caches still scale with concurrency.
      max_graph_batch: 32
      micro_batch_size: 4
      cfm_precapture_empty_cache: true
      cfm_max_graphs: 32
      # Capture the HiFT / default-voice Euler / flow-encoder graphs from the
      # worker warmup hook instead of on the first request. Stage 2 has no
      # warmup forward of its own, so the deferred sweep otherwise lands on the
      # first real request and blocks the engine for ~1-2 s per graph.
      #
      # These graphs still sit outside the profiled KV budget, exactly as on the
      # lazy path (the sweep runs after profiling), so keep headroom in
      # gpu_memory_utilization here. The move only changes when an OOM surfaces:
      # startup instead of the first request. Overlays that still set
      # cfm_graph_precapture_after_load get a warning; it no longer has any effect.
      cfm_graph_precapture_at_init: true
      # Default CUDA speaker path: CPU-reference TensorRT, not full DiT TensorRT.
      # Missing TensorRT falls back to the Torch speaker. Non-CUDA ignores the
      # flag. Set false in an overlay to keep Torch. token2wav_trt /
      # MINICPMO_TOKEN2WAV_TRT and token2wav_device_spk: false win when both
      # are set.
      token2wav_spk_cpu_reference: true
      token2wav_n_timesteps: 5

stages:
  - stage_id: 0
    max_num_seqs: 16
    # Leave headroom on the shared GPU for Talker KV + concurrent Code2Wav.
    # The NPU block below overrides this with measured single-card budgets.
    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.55
    enforce_eager: false
    # Thinker prefix caching stays off here: this profile serves duplex, whose
    # KV window refuses the cache (duplex/window_kv.py). minicpmo_4_5_turn.yaml
    # enables it for CUDA turn serving on both runners. Stage-0 n-gram
    # speculation stays off either way -- the omni prefix cache refuses it next
    # to enable_prefix_caching.
    enable_prefix_caching: false
    tensor_parallel_size: 1
    max_num_batched_tokens: 16384
    devices: "0"
    # Required for MiniCPM interleaved image/audio Daily-Omni packs (~78% recipe).
    # Keep these in YAML so they are applied through --deploy-config.
    interleave_mm_strings: true
    media_io_kwargs:
      video:
        fps: 1
        num_frames: 128
    limit_mm_per_prompt:
      # Daily-Omni: up to 64 interleaved image/audio pairs (1fps).
      image: 64
      audio: 64
      video: 1
    default_sampling_params:
      temperature: 0.0
      top_p: 1.0
      top_k: -1
      max_tokens: 2048
      seed: 42
      detokenize: true
      # 1.0 for MCQ accuracy; 1.1 can bias short A–D answers.
      repetition_penalty: 1.0

  - stage_id: 1
    max_num_seqs: 16
    # Preserve the checkpoint's full-attention Talker prompt while it fits;
    # native duplex rolls over to a one-chunk window at context capacity.
    # Leave device-level headroom for the colocated HiFi-GAN cuDNN workspace.
    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.15
    enforce_eager: false
    max_num_batched_tokens: 8192
    # Talker context is 4096 (tts_config.max_position_embeddings).
    max_model_len: 4096
    devices: "0"
    output_connectors:
      to_stage_2: connector_of_shared_memory
    # Talker is a single-vocab codec LM. These knobs go to vLLM's Sampler
    # (head_code logits). EOS is tts_config.eos_token_id (num_audio_tokens-1).
    # Values track upstream utils.TTSSamplingParams (min_p/win_size/tau_r are
    # declared there but never read, so they stay out). repetition_penalty is
    # consumed by the Talker, which rescores it over upstream's 16-frame window
    # instead of the Sampler's whole-stream presence penalty.
    # min_tokens is upstream's min_new_token.
    default_sampling_params:
      temperature: 0.8
      top_p: 0.85
      top_k: 25
      repetition_penalty: 1.05
      min_tokens: 50
      max_tokens: 4096
      seed: 42
      detokenize: false

  - stage_id: 2
    max_num_seqs: 16
    gpu_memory_utilization: 0.18
    enforce_eager: true
    enable_chunked_prefill: false
    max_num_batched_tokens: 65536
    max_model_len: 65536
    devices: "0"
    input_connectors:
      from_stage_1: connector_of_shared_memory
    default_sampling_params:
      temperature: 0.0
      top_p: 1.0
      top_k: -1
      max_tokens: 65536
      detokenize: true

platforms:
  cuda:
    model_runner: v2
    # Private MPS for colocated CUDA stages. NPU does not read this block.
    # A missing or failing nvidia-cuda-mps-control daemon, parallel stage
    # init, or a stage that is not one numeric GPU disables MPS and continues. Set false
    # in an overlay to disable it explicitly.
    cuda_mps: true
    stages:
      - stage_id: 0
        # Use native normalization for the CUDA duplex accuracy profile.
        # Keep Q/K normalization on this path by disabling its RoPE fusion.
        kernel_config:
          ir_op_priority:
            rms_norm: [native]
            fused_add_rms_norm: [native]
        compilation_config:
          custom_ops: [none, +silu_and_mul, +rotary_embedding]
          pass_config:
            fuse_norm_quant: false
            fuse_act_quant: false
            enable_qk_norm_rope_fusion: false
        # Match the CUDA Thinker backend used for Transformers accuracy validation.
        # Keep this scoped to stage 0; Talker retains its own backend selection.
        attention_backend: TRITON_ATTN
      - stage_id: 1
        # Talker multi-frame decode below runs only on V1; Thinker and Code2Wav
        # use MRv2.
        model_runner: v1
        # Full-attention occupancy is bounded by max_num_seqs * max_model_len
        # (16 * 4096 = 65536 tokens). Keep the reported CUDA KV token capacity
        # above that bound because physical-preemption replay is unsupported
        # (2 GiB holds ~35k tokens). The explicit cap leaves device headroom
        # for concurrent Stage 2.
        kv_cache_memory_bytes: 4294967296  # 4 GiB
        # Multi-frame decode: 8 codec frames per step, mirroring the NPU block.
        # The CUDA runner intercepts the step and injects the constant continue
        # drafts; stop_token_ids is the two-wide continue/stop id.
        #
        # async_scheduling: false is part of the contract, not a tuning knob:
        # K-step and async scheduling cannot be used together. Async books the
        # spec span one step ahead, while the multi-frame loop only executes
        # steps whose decode spans are uniform and whose booked positions stay
        # inside the prompt. Measured at c16/256: the booking first outruns the
        # prompt ("prefill span exceeds condition"), and once those slots are
        # padded the step still arrives with non-uniform spans ("multi-frame
        # Talker decode not engaged: request token spans are not uniform"),
        # which kills the stage-1 replica and fails every in-flight request.
        speculative_config:
          method: ngram
          num_speculative_tokens: 7
          prompt_lookup_min: 1
          prompt_lookup_max: 1
        async_scheduling: false
        default_sampling_params:
          stop_token_ids: [1]

  npu:
    # All three stages run MRv2. Same-card A/B (910B3 card 7, 2026-11-10,
    # HEAD 59a85c105, seed-tts en, warm tiers 32@1/64@4/128@8): mean audio
    # RTF 0.3181/0.5762/0.8795 (MRv2) vs 0.3199/0.5675/0.8764 (v1) --
    # -0.6%/+1.5%/+0.4%, within run-to-run noise (a second MRv2 run on the
    # same card differed by -0.4%/-4.4%/-1.6%). The c8 p99 audio-TTFP tail
    # (2419.6 ms vs v1 2267.0 ms, +6.7%) likewise overlaps the noise band
    # (second MRv2 run: 2274.8 ms). Runner-class selection on NPU is made
    # by vllm-ascend (env VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER overrides, MRv2 by
    # default); this key is validated but not consulted there -- pin v1
    # via the env var.
    model_runner: v2
    stages:
      - stage_id: 0
        # Keep the three stages' concurrency caps aligned so the top tier is
        # not gated by a single stage.
        max_num_seqs: 8
        # Measured single-card co-location budget (910B1). The turn-mode v1
        # KV check needs one full 40960-token request on this stage:
        # 144.8 KiB/token x 40960 = 5.62 GiB, so the KV pool must stay above
        # that -- 0.50 leaves only 4.79 GiB and engine init fails with
        # "estimated maximum model length is 33536"; main's platform value
        # 0.55 gives 7.85 GiB and passes CI (A3). At 0.55 stage 2 starved
        # into OOM on 910B1 once; re-verify the co-located tiers on both
        # before shrinking this again.
        gpu_memory_utilization: 0.55
        # 32768 leaves no KV cache on 910B1 at the colocated budgets above.
        # Audio Conv1d stays eager; the transformer stack is what this graph replays.
        additional_config:
          encoder_enable_npu_graph: true
          encoder_max_npu_graphs: 4  # Per encoder (vision/audio).
        max_num_batched_tokens: 8192
        # Moved here from the platform-shared block; see the base stage note.
        # Duplex KV window (window_kv.py) requires prefix caching disabled.
        enable_prefix_caching: false
        compilation_config:
          # Stage 0 carries no K-step, so nearly every step after prefill is a
          # uniform decode batch; one whole-step graph replays it without the
          # per-segment launch/sync cost of piecewise splitting. The static-shape
          # builder gates its runtime buckets on the decode graph mode, so
          # FULL_DECODE_ONLY covers those steps. Measured on 910B1 with the
          # three-stage co-located profile, seed-tts en, mean audio RTF at
          # 32@1 / 64@4 / 128@8: FULL_DECODE_ONLY 0.2749 / 0.5332 / 0.8346
          # versus PIECEWISE 0.3008 / 0.5428 / 0.8267, i.e. -8.6% at 32@1,
          # -1.8% at 64@4 and +0.9% at 128@8, inside this tier's ~2% run-to-run
          # scatter. FULL_AND_PIECEWISE was measured as well (0.2800 / 0.5354 /
          # 0.8337): no tier beats this mode and startup grows 20-70 s for the
          # second graph set, so stage 0 keeps the decode-only graph. Stage 1
          # below already ships FULL_DECODE_ONLY with the K-step.
          cudagraph_mode: FULL_DECODE_ONLY
      - stage_id: 1
        # Concurrency cap raised from 4 to 8; the override block only covered
        # stages 0 and 2, so stage 1 kept the base value of 4.
        max_num_seqs: 8
        # Match CUDA's fixed KV budget and leave headroom for Stage 2
        # (upstream #8735). When kv_cache_memory_bytes is not None, vLLM
        # reserves exactly that for KV and skips memory profiling, so the
        # gpu_memory_utilization below sizes nothing in this stage; it only
        # acts as the device-level headroom knob for the colocated HiFi-GAN
        # cuDNN workspace in the replica overlays that set this key to null
        # (measured on 910B1: ~5.2 GiB Talker KV at 0.10 vs the 4 GiB
        # fixed budget). Whether 4 GiB covers 8 concurrent Talker requests
        # with the K=8 step is pending a sweep re-run on the merged config.
        kv_cache_memory_bytes: 4294967296  # 4 GiB
        gpu_memory_utilization: 0.10
        max_num_batched_tokens: 8192
        # Multi-frame decode: 8 codec frames per step. NPU-only -- only the NPU
        # worker intercepts the step and injects the constant continue drafts,
        # so the block stays in this section. stop_token_ids below is the
        # two-wide continue/stop id that head emits; drop the block (or set it
        # to null) for one frame per step, and drop that id with it.
        speculative_config:
          method: ngram
          num_speculative_tokens: 7
          prompt_lookup_min: 1
          prompt_lookup_max: 1
        async_scheduling: false
        default_sampling_params:
          # The Talker's stop head emits this id to finish a request.
          stop_token_ids: [1]
        compilation_config:
          cudagraph_mode: FULL_DECODE_ONLY
      - stage_id: 2
        max_num_seqs: 8
        # 0.22 covers the 64k-token Code2Wav budget; the headroom that
        # survived a full three-tier concurrency sweep upstream (measured
        # on 910B1 under the pre-merge config, where stage 1's 0.10 was
        # still the live sizing knob). Stage 2 sets no kv_cache_memory_bytes,
        # so 0.22 remains the live knob here; re-verify on the merged config.
        gpu_memory_utilization: 0.22
        # Stage 2 stays outer-eager; CFM Whole-Euler, HiFT and encoder
        # graphs use the shared Code2Wav wrappers with NPUGraph (upstream
        # #8735).
        additional_config:
          code2wav_enable_npu_graph: true
          # Batch sizes round up to the next bucket before capture, so the
          # captured shape space becomes (#buckets x #mel buckets) instead of
          # one entry per observed batch size. Padded slots are all-zero
          # inputs and caches whose outputs are dropped; live slots keep their
          # own math, so this is a capture-key optimization only. Unset keeps
          # exact-batch capture.
          cfm_graph_batch_buckets: [1, 2, 4, 8]
          # Pool stays at 32. The CFM mel bucketing
          # (cfm_graph_bucket_frames: 16) only aligns the mel-frame dimension;
          # the capture key carries the full tensor shape
          # (NPUExactGraphRunner._tensor_signature), so the batch dimension
          # multiplies the shape space -- an 8-way concurrent stage-2 run
          # reaches 61 distinct shapes, not 19. Captured graph buffers are
          # allocated outside vLLM's gpu_memory_utilization budget, and this
          # profile co-locates three stages on one card (measured pre-merge
          # as 0.50 + 0.10 + 0.22 with 0.10 the live stage-1 knob; after the
          # merge stage 1 carries a fixed 4 GiB KV budget instead),
          # so a 64-entry pool OOMs the card at 128/8 while 32 completes all
          # three tiers. cfm_graph_batch_buckets above is what makes 32
          # sufficient: it collapses the batch axis so the 8-way shape space
          # fits inside the pool instead of overflowing it into eager replay.
          # It buys shape-space coverage, not graph memory -- both settings
          # capture up to the pool limit.
          code2wav_max_npu_graphs: 32
